summary.headline: Venetus 8 Astronomical Treatises
summary.text: Catalogue of Codex Venetus 8, listing Isaac Argyros’s Persian astronomical canons, Demetrios Chloros’s horoscope method, Gregoras’s corrected paschal cycle and astronomical tables, treatises on terrestrial zones, the Roman bissextile, astrolabe use and construction, horoscope calculation, geodesy, Heron’s geometry, conjunctions, full moons, ecliptic nodes, oracles, and ephemerides.
